basis: Independent complete source-level multi-solution validation and another reviewer's release-only reproduction establish a substantive resource capability. Final main audit now passes:32/32 final and observed,4 semantic/source-admissible repairs, with original service failures and same-context recovery separately preserved. Final rendered-manuscript and release packaging checks remain the root's responsibility.
what_changed_from_pre_main_review: The work now demonstrates why a reusable acceptance contract matters: two source-general repairs satisfy the same84-case historical/current/restart obligations, while naive exact-gold equality rejects60 valid observations for one policy. A nearby invalid policy completes all84 executions but fails every contract check. These are actual complete patches, independently applied through the release CLI, not synthetic observation edits or different text with identical behavior.
what_is_new_enough_to_submit: A small executable corpus with explicit artifact identities, bounded edit scopes, lifecycle behavior and calibrated multi-solution acceptance, accompanied by inspectable controls and measured Gemma conversations. The resource lets users evaluate correctness without treating one reference implementation's incidental output choices as uniquely required.
what_is_not_new: Real-version artifact replay, upgrade testing, restart checks, golden comparison and the underlying dtype ambiguity all have prior art. The document-wide deduction is a scoped reference alternative and validation tool; no universal new repair algorithm or first discovery is claimed.
remaining_award_risks: Only eight curated defect lineages across six projects; the most distinctive multi-solution validation concerns one lineage.
An editor may still judge the resource too small relative to the curation contribution. Larger dependent observation counts do not answer that criticism.
No natural-distribution failure rate, independent-hardware validation, external adoption, model-ranking effect or superiority to authentic upstream tests has been established.

The author-written v1 alternate repair had an empty-payload source-policy defect missed by the84 numeric checks. Its preserved record and separately frozen v2 correction must be disclosed; this reinforces the limits of finite contracts.
The Gemma scaffold has real editing/search constraints and external provider failures. A cleanly reported small baseline supports use of the resource, but cannot substitute for resource novelty.

criteria_potential_not_judge_scores.Novelty: Moderate, defensible as calibrated resource curation and multi-solution acceptance rather than new testing mechanisms.
criteria_potential_not_judge_scores.Quality_generalization: Strong internal validation with limited external validity; new independent projects and broader contracts remain future work.
criteria_potential_not_judge_scores.Relevance: Strong for code agents repairing durable Python data.
criteria_potential_not_judge_scores.Verifiability: Strong: genuine artifacts, allowed-only controls, immutable oracle, byte-bound candidates and independently executed release CLI.
criteria_potential_not_judge_scores.Clarity: Strong if the paper centers one usable resource and this operational contract result instead of inflating novelty or pooling exploratory studies.

recommended_positioning: Submit for Best New Resource with a concise resource-and-acceptance-validity contribution. Retain the zero-added-rejection authentic-upstream comparison. Do not claim high winning probability; the evidence supports worth submitting, not guaranteed competitiveness.
